links.outcome: Explanation fidelity (AOPC) and spatial agreement with pathologist annotations across XAI methods
links.effect: GradCAM++ best spatial agreement (IoU 0.52 ± 0.14, EfficientNetB3); SHAP best faithfulness (AOPC 0.61 ± 0.08). Method rankings preserved across binarisation thresholds. No user testing of clinical meaningfulness.
links.quote: GradCAM++ achieved the highest spatial agreement with pathologist annotations (mean IoU = 0.52 ± 0.14 for EfficientNetB3), while SHAP yielded the highest faithfulness scores (AOPC = 0.61 ± 0.08).

unlisted_practices: Comparing XAI methods quantitatively to select explanation methods for a tiered deployment strategy (GradCAM++, SHAP, squaregrid LIME)

screen.practice: explainability (XAI) method selection for pathology AI
screen.reason: The study conducts a quantitative comparative benchmark of post-hoc explainability methods (GradCAM, GradCAM++, SHAP, LIME) to guide XAI safeguard and method selection for clinical digital pathology deployment.

primary.practice: explainable AI / saliency map evaluation and selection
